text_block_list.text:
After finishing up some errands outside, 
as I was on my way back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! It's a special delivery 
from your local informant, Golshi-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, delivery made! Take that, black 
goat! Eat the letter, you beast, raaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Calling it out is a waste of time. ...Oh? 
I see.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ――Change of plans, pup. Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
A new pal is here-meow~ Hello-meow~♪ 
Welcome to the "Dreaming Animal Cafe"☆

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Read this.

I read through the letter's contents. In 
short, it says, 'Take your punishment game 
for losing the bet.'

Rather merciless instructions were given, 
like 'Recite the full menu name when 
ordering' and 'Take a cute two-shot photo 
with the store mascot☆'—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's the price of losing a bet, so I won't 
complain. —I'm gonna record the whole 
thing on video and turn you in.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"One 'Little Bird's Flower Garden Salad♪' 
and one 'Dream Bunny's ☆ First Love 
Drink', please."

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"One Colorful Salad and a Carrot Juice!" 
Coming right up-nyan~♪

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Wansuke-kun~ Are you ready, meow~? Let's 
get along and say cheese☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

...Recording the video was surprisingly 
more exhausting. Only one order left. The 
final order is...

—"End your sentences with 'pyon' and make 
yourself cute-pyon☆"...!
choice_data_list:
(Even for Sirius, this might be a bit 
much...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hey you, got a sec-“pyon”?

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes! Ready to order-nya~?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'd like to order some sweets, but 
do you have any recommendations, pyon?"

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... My recommendation is the "Sleepy 
Kitty Parfait♪", nya!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well then, one of that "Sleepy Kitty 
Parfait", please... and let me touch your 
hair a bit-pyon.

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"You had cotton candy on you, pyon. 
...Quite the clumsy one, aren't you, 
pyon?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, with fur this well-groomed, I guess 
you can't help wanting to snuggle up, 
pyon?

text_block_list.name: Cute Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text: T-That's not true at all, meow~♪

Despite bearing the overwhelming handicap 
of saying "pyon," Sirius Symboli 
completely charmed the clerk. Seeing how 
masterfully she handled it all...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah! Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess it's time to head home. Those 
guys are probably waiting on pins and 
needles for me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as always, isn't it?! It's 
the same as it's always been!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The first two are fine, but... you've 
failed to carry out the final directive, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Hah! What are you talking about? ...No 
matter how you look at it, it's a cute 
'pyon', right?"

And so, Sirius Symboli delightfully 
provoked Nakayama Festa and the others.

"The more I thought I shouldn't laugh, the 
less I could stop, eventually bringing 
tears to my eyes. However—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Laughing at your master? Clever puppy, 
aren't you? Looks like you need some 
discipline.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong? Laugh all you want. I'll 
wait for ya.
choice_data_list:
By the way, when you say 'discipline', 
what exactly are you planning to make me 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer and their Umamusume share the 
same fate. If so, there's only one thing 
to do, right?
choice_data_list:
Don't tell me I have to do that punishment 
game too...!?

Don't tell me I have to do that punishment 
game too...!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—And that's how this video came to be. 
Blushing bright red, poor thing... Heh 
heh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This deep red... Is it deep-sea vinegared 
octopus or common octopus?! Please, chant 
the name of that dish for me right now!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Cute pup, isn't it? Feel free to look at 
it as much as you'd like.

She kept bringing up that video after 
that, teasing me relentlessly about it for 
a while.
